items.productDescription: APS5000 lithium-ion batteries are CEC listed and proven to be easy to install and compatible with any quality inverter. The batteries can operate with or without communications with and inverter.
The HaloDyne Series are all cyclic, or deep cycle, batteries using Sodium Ion(Na) Technology. They can also be used for uninterrupted power supply(UPS) or standby applications.

HaloDyne APSI2500 rack mounted batteries are perfect for off-grid and grid connected energy storage systems.

HaloDyne APSI2500 has a BMS and communications for maximizing performance, safety and remote monitoring.

The StatoDyne series are Uninterrupted Power Supply(UPS) or standby/backup rechargeable batteries using Sodium Ion(Na) Technology. They are not designed for cyclic/deep cycle or starting applications.

StatoDyne APSI2500 UPS rack mounted batteries are perfect for off-grid and grid connected energy storage systems.

StatoDyne APSI2500 UPS does not require a BMS, operating just like a lead-acid battery.
